def clean(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0]); out=[r[:] for r in I]
    import collections
    # separators first: lines fully uniform and spanning full length
    seprows=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(I[i]))==1]
    sepcols=[j for j in range(W) if len({I[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1]
    # inside each band cell: color kept if adjacent to same color (orthogonally)
    nb=[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if r in seprows or c in sepcols: continue
            same=sum(1 for dr,dc in nb if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W and I[r+dr][c+dc]==I[r][c])
